name: radm2
description: WOOF's speciation of anthropogenic inventory fields (kg m-2 s-1) into the emis_ant rows WRF-Chem's emiss_opt = 3 reads for RADM2 / RADM2SORG (gases mol km-2 hr-1, aerosols ug m-2 s-1). Each row is the sum of its terms (field x weight, float64), clamped at zero where clamp_at_zero is set. WOOF's choices, not WRF's: WRF reads emis_ant ready-made.
deviations: HERMESv3's printed RADM2 profile omits voc15 (xylene) from every class and lists voc17 (other aromatics) in both HC8 and XYL; WOOF assigns xylene and other aromatics once each, to XYL (Stockwell et al. 1990: XYL is xylene and the more reactive aromatics).

Acids: HERMESv3 gives 0.44 to ORA1 and 0.56 to ORA2; add_anthropogenics' RADM2 branch adds no e_ora1 (woof.core.chem_radm2_emiss.GAS_TERMS), so the formic share is not emitted and only ORA2's 0.56 is.
Ethyne: 0.4 of its mass to HC3 (HERMESv3's reactivity-weighted share); the rest, like voc25 'Others' (8.1%, no stated composition) and the shares of benzene outside TOL, is not emitted.

e_so2.provenance: SO2 mass / 64.066 g mol-1; all of EDGAR's SO2 is gas (no primary sulfate split: see e_so4i)

e_no.provenance: 0.9 of NOx moles (mass / 46.0050 g mol-1) as NO. NOx is NO2-equivalent mass (Crippa et al. 2023, ESSD 15, 2667-2694); molar split 90 % NO / 10 % NO2 of primary NOx, Crippa et al. 2018, ESSD 10, 1987-2013, p. 1989

e_no2.provenance: 0.1 of NOx moles (mass / 46.0050 g mol-1) as NO2, the complement of e_no. NOx is NO2-equivalent mass (Crippa et al. 2023, ESSD 15, 2667-2694); molar split 90 % NO / 10 % NO2 of primary NOx, Crippa et al. 2018, ESSD 10, 1987-2013, p. 1989

caps.provenance: EC + OM never exceeds the cell's PM2.5 (Simpson et al. 2012, ACP 12, 7825-7865, Sect. 6.3): where BC + 1.3 OC is above EDGAR's PM2.5 (two independent inventories and a fixed OM:OC), the four carbon rows are scaled by PM2.5 / (their sum), keeping their i/j and EC/OM ratios; the residual PM2.5 rows are then zero by their clamp.
